title: 21 trends for 2021 (21 meaningful, trend-driven innovation opportunities for 2021)
notes: Free landing page on info.trendwatching.com, first archived 2020-12-01 (published on or before that date; no date printed). Framed as 'opportunities' rather than trends; each item has a label, a one-line subtitle (in note), one innovation example and a claim paragraph (quote). target_year 2021 from the title except WORKERS, INC. (horizon 'the 2020s'). The paid 2021 Trend Report (Premium) is not captured.

entries.label: 15-MINUTE CITIES
entries.quote: We’re steadily moving towards people-first, car-free urban environments that prioritize wellbeing.
entries.subject: 15-minute cities and car-free urban design
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Boost urban wellbeing and community'.

entries.label: PANDEMOMENT
entries.quote: 2021 is about laying the groundwork for a more purposed recovery.
entries.subject: Post-COVID build-back-better business
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Turn crisis into transformational opportunity'.

entries.label: DESIGNED FOR WELLBEING
entries.quote: In 2021, increasingly mindful people will look for products and services that seamlessly boost their mental wellbeing.
entries.subject: Mental wellbeing built into products
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Infuse mental wellness into your products'.

entries.label: VIRTUALLY GROUNDED
entries.quote: The accelerated race to champion virtual events has only begun
entries.subject: Virtual events and gatherings
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Reimagine gatherings for today's mixed reality'.

entries.label: OLD SPICE
entries.quote: As longevity increases, people can, want and need to be productive for longer.
entries.subject: Hiring older workers
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Expand expertise by hiring older talent'.

entries.label: PLANT-ED
entries.quote: The plant-based revolution is hitting industries everywhere.
entries.subject: Plant-based products across industries
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Join the plant-based revolution'.

entries.label: SYSTEMIC JUSTICE
entries.quote: In 2021, cynical consumers demand authentic social justice initiatives of, for and by those who have been sidelined.
entries.subject: Brand social-justice initiatives
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Support and empower marginalized communities'.

entries.label: TRANSCYCLING
entries.quote: And in 2021, brands will increasingly make use of their waste to enter new markets.
entries.subject: Waste upcycled into new product categories
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Use waste to enter new markets'.

entries.label: ROBO-ROAMING
entries.quote: While fully autonomous cars are unlikely to roam the roads in 2021, we will see wider adoption of robots across different industries: in forests , on farms and in cities .
entries.subject: Robots in agriculture, forestry and cities
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Adopt robots to automate and data-ify'.

entries.label: TALENT TRANSFER
entries.quote: But offering support and assistance to former employees can be a big boost to the morale of current and future employees.
entries.subject: Support for laid-off employees
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Care for employees, even after departure'.

entries.label: EXTRA-MILE SUSTAINABILITY
entries.quote: consider unconventional routes to building truly sustainable and ethical business operations.
entries.subject: Unconventional sustainable supply chains
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Take unconventional routes to greener products'.

entries.label: NORM RECALIBRATION
entries.quote: new norms — in gender, media, education and more — will dictate how brands communicate with their audiences, and what those audiences expect from brands.
entries.subject: Changing social norms (gender, media, education)
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Accept, embrace and run with new norms'.

entries.label: CARBON LABELLING
entries.quote: Not just food brands, but restaurants and fashion brands are increasingly adopting carbon labelling to educate consumers on the hidden costs of products while gaining a new competitive advantage.
entries.subject: Carbon labels on products
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Reveal true costs and gain consumer trust'.

entries.label: DIGITAL PARITY
entries.quote: In 2021, the demand for creative ways to provide access to all will be higher than ever.
entries.subject: Digital inclusion and internet access
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Providing online access to all'.

entries.label: MINDSUMERS
entries.quote: Increasingly mindful shoppers demand that brands acknowledge the detrimental impact of hyperconsumerism and offer them more than just ‘more’.
entries.subject: Anti-overconsumption and mindful shopping
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Help consumers stop and (not) shop'.

entries.label: BLURRED GAMING
entries.quote: Enabling consumers to use virtual currency, goods and actions to achieve real-world impact is a surefire way to attract attention.
entries.subject: Games with real-world effects
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Bring virtual playgrounds into 'real life''.

entries.label: WORKERS, INC.
entries.quote: Uncovering and transforming business models that are harmful to employees will be a leitmotif of the 2020s.
entries.subject: Employee ownership
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Transform employees into owners'. Horizon in text: 'the 2020s'.

entries.label: EARTH POSITIVE
entries.quote: In 2021, regenerative farming products will make their way into consumers' hands, giving early adopter brands a clear competitive advantage among eco-progressive consumers.
entries.subject: Regenerative agriculture products
entries.note: Subtitle: 'From climate neutral to regenerative'.

entries.label: AMBIENT LEARNING
entries.quote: As kids spend more time indoors looking at screens, analog home products that intrinsically spark learning and creativity are increasingly important.
entries.subject: Educational home products for children
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Spark learning through interior design'.

entries.label: LAB TO TABLE
entries.quote: In 2021, once-ridiculed lab-grown meat will make its way onto consumers' plates while accelerating the overhaul of the traditional livestock industry.
entries.subject: Cultivated (lab-grown) meat
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Lab-grown meat is coming of age'.

entries.label: OMNI-ACCESSIBILITY
entries.quote: And creative solutions might end up improving your products and services for everyone.
entries.subject: Accessible design for people with disabilities
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Design for people of all abilities'. The section states that 15% of the world's population has some form of disability (present figure, not a forecast).
